texts: Added multiplayer support to the Voiceline Guesser.

Added a guard to the Artwork Guesser to prevent it from generating crops that are mostly a single color. This does not prevent "vague" crops, only those that are almost entirely black or some other color. The exact parameters of this guard may be adjusted in the future.
Added navigational links to the footer.
Added navigational links to the other identities or E.G.Os of the sinner in their respective identity and E.G.O pages.
Fixed a bug that caused the problem generators of both guessers to do unnecessary extra processing on the infinite and multiplayer modes.
